title: POAPcet
tagline: Public good to onboard testing users with POAP as access control
description: This project is a public good to help developers and learning communities onboard testing users to prototypes and pre-productions apps. POAPcet requires users to hold a POAP defined by devs or event organizers in order to deliver a small amount of testnet currencies for gas fees.
how_its_made: We will build a faucet and an access control contract working on a next.js app that fetches POAPs held by users through POAP API . We are planning to deploy on Optimism and Gnosis testnets.
